args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in production after it was deployed (unhealthy, 18% error rate in us-east, us-west and eu-west). Note: v2.3.1-rc was also marked unhealthy in staging. Action taken: rolled checkout-api back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback was approved by a human approver. Follow-up: confirm health and error rate are back to normal on v2.3.0, and find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001. The service is passing health checks again.

- **What failed:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed checks in staging before it went out.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the newest release that was healthy in production. A human approver signed off, and it's now live in all three regions. checkout-api now passes health checks, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure and the rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged. It suggests watching that health holds on v2.3.0 and finding the cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it.
